//: Type-checks the committed TypeScript owned by the config-schema generator.
The main CLI project excludes `@generated`, so this standard nested project keeps generated sources
editor-discoverable and checks that the generated module parses. The schema itself uses `@ts-nocheck` because
semantically checking a 100k-line generated Zod expression consumes gigabytes without validating authored code;
runtime config-validation tests prove its behavior and its explicit ZodType annotation keeps consumers checked.
`types: []` keeps unrelated ambient packages out of the program. `DOM` supplies the standard URL type used by
Zod's public declarations without loading unrelated ambient packages.
